harvestedTerms.summary: Narayanan and Unger's essay presents a research agenda for reorienting AI away from the automation paradigm toward human-AI collaboration. They introduce four technical directions: white-box agents (epistemically legible intermediate processes), low-latency real-time interaction, and implicitly others. The piece is substantively contrarian, rooting its argument in HCI history and economic evidence, and explicitly challenging the AGI-as-full-automation telos dominant in Silicon Valley.

mustReadFlagged.reason: A rare thing: a serious, positive research agenda — not just critique — for a genuinely different direction in AI development. Narayanan and Unger name concrete technical problems (process traces, white-box agents, real-time interaction) that the automation paradigm systematically ignores. Essential reading for anyone who wants to understand what a substantive alternative to the AGI-as-automation consensus actually looks like in practice.

harvestedTerms.summary: Google's blog post announces the winner of the Future Vision XPRIZE — a competition for hopeful AI-enabled films co-run with Range Media Partners. The winning short film 'The Gifted' depicts an 11-year-old recreating his late mother's voice using AI to quietly serve his community. The post is primarily a press/outreach announcement with minimal terminological substance.

article.title: A quote from Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

harvestedTerms.summary: A brief Simon Willison quote-post collecting a passage from Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang on how the Claude Code team has restructured code review — shifting from a gate at the end of the PR process to continuous AI-assisted review running inline while code is written. The key framing is that 'did a human read the code?' is an imprecise proxy for the real question of what checks best catch what risks.

Anthropic's detailed account of election safeguards for the 2026 US midterms, covering conversation analysis methodology, political bias evaluation, trusted-source integrations, and misuse policy enforcement. Introduces several election-integrity-specific practices including multi-group independent bias audits, a political evenhandedness evaluation metric, and a TurboVote/Democracy Works integration. Most content is operational and policy-specific rather than terminologically generative.
